name: Auto audio & subtitles
description: Remembers the audio and subtitle tracks each viewer picks for a show and picks the closest match on every other episode, on every device.
author: Kinora

settings.label: Use the library's last choice for new shows
settings.help: A show (or movie) you haven't picked tracks for yet starts with what you last picked in the same library, e.g. Japanese audio with English subtitles in an anime library. On by default.

settings.label: Remember per season
settings.help: Keep a separate choice for each season instead of one per show. A season without its own choice still uses the show's. Off by default.
